phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Gasterosteus aculeatus (56 µm, detail scale)

equations.activator: du/dt = Du ∇²u + γ (a − u + u² v)
equations.steady_state: u0 = a + b, v0 = b / (a + b)²
equations.jacobian: f_u = −1 + 2 u0 v0, f_v = u0², g_u = −2 u0 v0, g_v = −u0²
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c² = γ (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.turing_conditions: tr J < 0, det J > 0, Dv f_u + Du g_v > 0, (Dv f_u + Du g_v)² > 4 Du Dv det J

parameters.dx_um_note: Chosen so the Holocene analytic λ_c is exactly 56 µm. Marine and benthic use the same dx; only a changes.

chronospecies_contrast_at_this_scale.statement: At 56 µm the quantity that moves relative to the marine predecessor and the benthic successor is the cellular carrier wavelength selected by k_c, via basal activator production a (Kitlg direction). It is not a copy of the 2.4 mm or 2.2 mm organ-scale bar periods.
chronospecies_contrast_at_this_scale.a_is: A reconstructed direction knob consistent with reduced freshwater Kitlg (Miller et al. 2007), not a measured production rate.

specimen.download_note: 1920 px Wikimedia thumbnail of the 3506×2000 original, stored and hashed as vendored.
specimen.creator: Holger Krisp
specimen.gallery_fallback_not_used: datasets/species_gallery/I_Enaima_Vertebrata/Gasterosteus_aculeatus.jpg is a synthetic lavender field with a caption, not a specimen photograph.

reported_in_source: Turing (1952) diffusion-driven instability and a selected wavelength
Miller et al. (2007): freshwater sticklebacks reduced pigmentation via lower Kitlg expression relative to marine fish
Greenwood et al. (2011): juvenile stickleback pigment-pattern divergence has a mapped genetic basis
Tapanes & Rennison (2024): benthic vs limnetic melanophore density and lateral barring map to different chromosomes
Colosimo et al. (2005) Eda plate armor and Chan et al. (2010) Pitx1 pelvic reduction frame the marine-to-benthic chronoseries at organ scale
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg parameters (a, b, Du, Dv, gamma) chosen so the Holocene analytic λ_c equals the assigned 56 µm
a = 0.28 / 0.20 / 0.14 as a Kitlg-direction knob, not a fitted biochemical rate
Vertical bar envelope on the photograph is a separate organ-scale prepattern measured on this image; it is not k_c
transfer_boundary: Nakamasu et al. (2009) showed zebrafish pigment cells can satisfy Turing conditions. That network is not a stickleback measurement.
does_not_claim: That 56 µm was measured on the Krisp photograph (the file has no scale bar and cannot resolve 56 µm)
That Schnakenberg kinetics are the published stickleback melanophore model
That the model predicts lateral-plate number or Pitx1 pelvic loss
